He wants to scrape HTML data to gather articles on stock market trends and investment advice. Mark requests the smart agent to help him scrape this data and perform clustering analysis to group articles based on themes such as market predictions, investment strategies, and economic indicators. The insights gained from this clustering will enable Mark to provide strategic recommendations to his clients based on current financial trends.
